summary: The Sync - Release Notes & API Diffs workflow completed three October 5 agent jobs without emitting a safe output, preventing its intended release-notes pull request from being created.

stepsToReproduce: Run the Sync - Release Notes & API Diffs workflow when its Prepare job produces changes.
Observe that agent runs 37337819624, 37353540905, and 37358154667 complete without a safe output.

repoLinks.description: Earlier instance of the same no-safe-output failure, closed as a historical report without asserting that it was fixed.
Related workflow failure caused by a missing bash-allowlist tool; fixed by PR #5260.
Merged workflow allowlist fix for the related missing-tool failure.

analysis.summary: The workflow source configures a create-pull-request safe output and tells the release-notes agent to emit it after committing generated content. The compiled workflow initializes a safe-output artifact client, provides the safeoutputs tool to the Copilot harness, and copies its output file for processing. Consequently, the reports establish that the expected output was absent but do not establish whether the agent omitted the call, the call failed, or the output transport failed; the failed-run logs must be inspected before selecting a code change.
analysis.rationale: This is a repeatable CI automation failure, not a documentation request: three agent jobs produced no required workflow output. The workflow belongs to the build/CI surface and blocks automated release-note synchronization, so it is a medium-severity reliability bug. A historical report has the same symptom, but was explicitly closed only to reset monitoring and did not identify a root cause, so this issue should remain open for investigation rather than be closed as a duplicate.

keySignals.interpretation: The workflow's agent stage completed without a recorded safe-output declaration.
The symptom recurred after the initial reported run.

keySignals.text: This closure does not assert that every historical failure is fixed.
keySignals.interpretation: The prior identical report is related evidence, not a confirmed duplicate resolution.

codeInvestigation.finding: The source workflow selects the Copilot engine, declares create-pull-request as its safe output, and instructs the agent to commit then call that output after rendering release-note changes.

The compiled workflow configures the safe-output artifact client and output path, starts the Copilot harness with the safeoutputs tool allowed, and copies the safe-output JSONL for downstream processing.
The agent job is gated on Prepare producing a non-empty patch, so the workflow expects an agent-created pull request whenever this agent stage runs.

workarounds: No validated reporter-side workaround was found; a maintainer can manually rerun the workflow only after preserving the failed agent and safe-output processing logs needed for diagnosis.
nextQuestions: Did each failed agent invoke create-pull-request, noop, missing_tool, or missing_data according to the agent transcript?
Did the safe-output processor receive an empty JSONL file, a malformed declaration, or an artifact-transfer failure?
Did the agent have a clean worktree after rendering, causing it to exit without a commit or output?

resolution.hypothesis: The agent either exits before declaring create-pull-request/noop or its safe-output declaration is not reaching the workflow processor; source configuration alone cannot distinguish these paths.

proposals.title: Inspect the three failed runs' agent and safe-output logs
proposals.description: Compare the Copilot transcript, safe-output JSONL artifact, and processor step for runs 37337819624, 37353540905, and 37358154667 to identify the first point where output is absent.

proposals.title: Harden the terminal safe-output path after diagnosis
proposals.description: Once the failing boundary is known, make the workflow prompt or runtime path emit the appropriate safe output explicitly for both changed and unchanged worktrees, then validate it with a controlled workflow run.

resolution.recommendedProposal: Inspect the three failed runs' agent and safe-output logs
resolution.recommendedReason: The current issue and checked-in workflow establish the missing result but not its cause; changing the prompt or transport before examining the run artifacts risks masking the failure.

actionability.reason: The workflow contract and repeated symptom are clear, but the available issue content lacks the agent and safe-output processing logs required to identify the failing boundary.
